name: Bow Arc
author: Glutoblop
description: Shows a faint dotted arc of where your arrow will fly as you draw your bow, with a ring where it will land.

changelog.0.1.2: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin).
changelog.0.1.1: Double the ammo icon's default size (40 -> 80)
changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: dotted trajectory arc while drawing a bow, appearing almost as soon as you draw, with an impact ring and a brief equipped-arrow icon above the crosshair.
